about: Where every embedded asset file comes from and on what terms. tests/structure.rs (backrooms) checks that each crates/game/assets/*.bin, textures/*.jpg, voice/<persona>/*.wav and cutscenes.json has an entry, that its fingerprint (FNV-1a 64 of the file, written by cargo xtask assets) matches, that its licence and generator are allowed, and that its sources exist. A generative model (image-to-3D, AI audio) may be used only if it is in allowed_models, which records models whose licence allows commercial use everywhere the game ships; non-commercial weights (AudioGen, MMAudio) and territory-limited ones (Hunyuan3D 2.1) are not allowed.
allowed_generators: written by hand, compiled by scripts

bodies.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction; the bodies that were people start from MakeHuman's base mesh and targets (CC0 1.0, the MakeHuman team)
bodies.bin.built_with: Blender 5.2.2 LTS headless: skeletons, bodies (MakeHuman's hm08 base and its targets, or metaballs), voxel remesh, displacement, decimation, bone-heat weights, vertex paint; packed by cargo xtask assets creatures
bodies.bin.rebuild: cargo xtask assets creatures [--only …] [--write]; the MakeHuman files and their SHA-1s are in assets/src/creatures/sources.json (fetched once into target/creature-sources/)

creature_meshes.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction
creature_meshes.bin.built_with: Blender headless: rigid parts by creatures.py, skinned bodies by skinned.py and the skin_*.py scripts over rest-pose rig dumps, packed into this file (SKINNED.md); kept as stored
creature_meshes.bin.rebuild: none: its scripts need rest-pose rig dumps that nothing in this repository writes; kept as stored until its last parts in use (shBody, stairFace) move to new bodies; see assets/README.md

cutscenes.json.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction
cutscenes.json.built_with: cargo xtask cutscene write (TOML sources, every field written out)
cutscenes.json.generator: written by hand, compiled by scripts

prop_meshes.bin.authors: written by coding agents under the developer's direction
prop_meshes.bin.built_with: Blender headless: props.py runs every batch module in assets/src/blender/props/ (propkit shapes, seeded noise, weighted normals); packed by cargo xtask assets props, the frozen parts kept as stored
prop_meshes.bin.frozen_parts_reason: built before the build was repeatable: their noise came from mathutils.noise.noise_vector, which gives different values in every Blender process. propkit.noise3 replaced it on 2026-10-25, so a rebuild now repeats, but gives these parts new shapes; core_props_head, core_props_tail and props fixtures sample some of them. Rebuild them with --write --rebuild-frozen together with re-recorded fixtures.
prop_meshes.bin.rebuild: cargo xtask assets props [--write]; Blender 5.2.2 reproduces every part but the frozen ones exactly
